name: Puffco | New Peak | Sapphire
description: The Peak is the most effortless dab experience ever. Smarter, simpler, and comfy in-hand, our original intelligent vaporizer now features a 3D Chamber, Joystick Cap, and real-time temperature control. With its seamless single-button interface, premium water filtration and four dialed heat presets, the Peak makes enjoying hash easy — every time.
